s: Issur rechitza beyom hakkippurim ubo k"a seipim: rechitza ketzad? Kol rechitza shel taanug asura beyom hakkippurim, mishshum "asher lo teunneh vego'", lepikak asur lirchotz miqtzat gupo kekol gupo ben bechammin ben betzonen, vaapillu lehoshit etzbao bemayim — asur. Abal im hayu yadayv o raglayv o shear maqom bekol gupo meluklak betit o betzoa, o shennatap dam mechotmo — muttar lerochtzo, kevan sheeno mitkavven letaanug, raq sheyyizzaher shello yirchotz ella maqom hamtunnap bilbad:

Veken babboqer keshenneor mishshenato — notel yadayv g' peamim kemo shennitbaer besiman d' (mittaam shennitbaer besiman tqn"d), vibarek "al netilat yadayim". Veyizzaher shello yittol ella ad sop qishre etzbeotayv, velo yekavven lahanaat rechitza raq lehaabir haruach raa meal hayyadayim. Uleachar shenniggeb yadayv bemappa — maabir hammappa al gabbe enayv, lehaabir mehem cheble shena:

Veim yesh likluk al gabbe enayv vedarko lerochtzam bekol yemot hashshana — rochetz otam kedarko veeno choshesh. Veken mi shehu istenis veen dato meyushshebet alayv ad sheyyeqanneach panayv bemayim — muttar lo leqanneach bemayim beyom hakkippurim. Abal hamminhag lehachamir sheapillu mi shehu istenis en meqanneach panayv velo enayv bemayim, ella im ken yesh liplup al panayv o al gabbe enayv, sheaz muttar lekol adam lirchotz kedarko bekol hashshana:

Im hetil me raglayim veshipshep beyadayv lehaabir hannitzotzot meal raglayv, o sheasa tzerakayv veqinnach beyado — muttar lo lirchotz yadayv ad sop qishre etzbeotayv lehaabir mehen hallikluk, ukede lebarek "asher yatzar" beyadayim neqiyyot. Abal im lo shipshep velo qinnach beyado — lo yittol yadayv kelal, shemmuttar lebarek "asher yatzar" belo netilat yadayim, kevan shello nitlakleku yadayv. Veharotzeh littol yadayv qodem sheyyebarek "asher yatzar" — yeshapshep beyado viqannach kede sheyyitztarek littol yadayv, veken nakon laasot kede lebarek "asher yatzar" beyadayim neqiyyot utehorot:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Belel yom hakkippurim achar hattepilla, abal qodem hattepilla, o bayyom shemmitpalelin kol hayyom, im hetil mayim ap al pi shello shipshep beyadayv, o sheasa tzerakayv ap al pi shello qinnach beyado — muttar littol yadayv ad sop qishre etzbeotayv, shemmitzva lehitpallel beyadayim tehorot birchitza, shenneemar "hikkon liqrat eloheka yisrael":

Veken kohen haoleh laddukan — notel yadayv, ap al pi shennatal yadayv qodem hattepilla. Veken hallevi bemaqom shennohagin shehallevi notel yadayv qodem sheyyotzeq mayim al yede hakkohen — muttar lo littol beyom hakkippurim, kevan sheeno mitkavven letaanug. Ulepikak habba min hadderek veraglayv kehot — muttar lerochtzan, kevan sheeno mitkavven ella lirpua, veken kol keyotze bezeh:
Asur lirchotz piv beyom hakkippurim kemo shennitbaer besiman tqs"z, ayyen sham:

Haholek lebet hammidrash, o lehaqbil pene abiv o pene rabbo o mi sheggadol mimmennu bechokma, o letzorke shear mitzvot — yakol laabor bammayim ad tzavvaro, ben bahalika ben bachazara, veen choshesh mishshum issur rechitza beyom hakkippurim, kevan sheholek lidbar mitzva, veod sheeno mitkavven letaanug. Ubilbad sheyyaaseh shinnuy mikkol ober bammayim bechol, dehaynu shello yotzi yadayv mittachat sepat chaluqo kede lehagbiah chaluqo meat kemo sheosin kol obere bammayim bechol, kede sheal yede hashshinnuy yizkor shehayyom eno chol velo yabo lischot et begadayv. Veap al pi shebbeged sheriyyato bemayim zehu kibbuso ap al pi sheeno sochato kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"b, ap al pi ken hittiru laabor bammayim beyom hakkippurim, mishshum shello amrinan sheriyyato zehu kibbuso ella im ken haya meluklak qodem hashsheriyya kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"b, ayyen sham:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beammat hammayim sheen memayv rodepim maher, abal nachal shemmemayv rodepin maher veshotepin — ap bechol asur laabor bo, apillu en hammayim maggiin lo ella meat lemala mimmotnayv, mippene hassakkana shello yishtepuhu hammayim:

En hetter laabor bammayim lidbar mitzva ella kesheober bammayim atzman, abal laabor bispina qetanna — asur apillu lidbar mitzva, lepi shello hittiru lidbar mitzva ella issur rechitza kevan sheen mitkavven letaanug, abal laabor bispina sheyyesh bazeh shebut gamur middibre soperim kemo shennitbaer besiman rm"ch veshal"t — heemidu chakamim et dibrehem lebattel mitzva besheb veal taaseh:

Harab asur laabor bammayim kede leqabbel pene talmido. Vaapillu lehaqbil pene chabero asur, im en chabero gadol mimmennu bechokma. Abal im rotzeh lishol debar halaka mechabero o mittalmido shellamad gam etzel chakamim acherim, veen tzarik lomar im holek lilmod im talmidim kegon sheen hattalmid yakol labo etzlo — muttar lo laabor bammayim bahalika ubachazara:

Haholek lishmor perotayv — muttar lo laabor bammayim, ap al pi sheen mitzva bahalikato, mikkol maqom mishshum hepsed mamono hittiru lo laabor. Abal bachazarato — asur laabor, sheen bekak hepsed mamon im lo yachazor limqomo ad leachar yom hakkippurim:

Ap bemaqom shehittiru lo laabor bammayim — lo yaabor ella im ken en lo derek acheret sheyyakol lehaggia limchoz cheptzo im lo yaabor bammayim, abal im yesh lo derek acheret lehaqqip et hammayim apillu hi arukka mizzo — mutab sheyyarbeh behilluk lehaqqip et hammayim veal yaabor bammayim, sheyyesh kan chashash rechitza, veod shehu qarob labo lide sechita:

Muttar lehitztannen betit ap al pi sheyyesh bo qetzat lachluchit, veen bo mishshum issur rechitza, abal im yesh bo kol kak lachut ad sheim yanniach alayv yado taaleh bah lachut kol kak ad sheim yadbiqenna leyado acheret tidbaq bah hallachut sheqqibbela min hattit, vezehu niqra topeach al menat lehatpiach — asur lehitztannen bo, mippene shezzehu kerochetz bemayim:

Umuttar lehitztannen bekol mine perot, ubetinoq, ubekol mine kelim hareqim, ben shehem shel kesep vezahab ben shehem shel cheres, shello aseru ella rechitza bemayim, abal asur lehitztannen bekelim sheyyesh bahem mayim apillu enan meleim, shemma yitnaneu hakkelim veyishshapeku hammayim shebbahen al gupo, venimtza rochetz beyom hakkippurim:

Ap al pi shemmin haddin muttar lishrot mappa bemayim beereb yom hakkippurim umotziah min hammayim qodem yom hakkippurim umitnaggebet veholeket ad shello yehe bah topeach al menat lehatpiach veaz meqanneach bah panayv yadayv veraglayv kede lehitztannen, ap al pi sheeno oseh lehaabir hallikluk ella kede lehitanneg, ap al pi ken muttar min haddin kevan shehi neguba min hammayim, kemo shennitbaer besiman tqn"d leinyan tisha beab, mikkol maqom beyom hakkippurim yesh lehachamir, lepi sheim haya meqanneach bemappa sheenah neguba min hammayim — yesh bekan issur min hattora mishshum sechita, lepikak yesh lehachamir ap binguba min hammayim shehayu aleha mibbeod yom, gezera shemma lo titnaggeb yapeh viqannach bah veyabo lide sechita:
Choleh ap al pi sheen bo sakkana — muttar lirchotz kedarko beyom hakkippurim:
Hakkalla achar nissueha — mutteret lirchotz paneha beyom hakkippurim, lepi shehi tzerika lehitnaot ad shettitchabbeb al balah. Vekol sheloshim yom lechuppatah hi qeruya kalla:

Mi sheraa qeri beyom hakkippurim bizman hazzeh, shebbotla taqqanat ezra shettiqqen tebila lebaal qeri — asur lo litbol o lishpok alayv tisha qabbin, apillu mi shennoheg kak bekol yemot hashshana — lo yinhag ken beyom hakkippurim, sheen minhag lehattir et haasur ella leesor et hammuttar, ella im haqqeri adayin hu lach — meqannecho bemappa vedayyo, veim nityabbesh kebar o shennitlaklek bibsaro — rochetz bammeqomot hamluklakin shebbo lebad umitpallel:

Asur leishsha litbol belel yom hakkippurim apillu higgia zeman tebilatah belayla zo, kevan sheasura leshammesh belayla zo — en bitbilatah mitzva kelal, lepi mah sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman qtz"z ditbila bizmannah lav mitzva hi ella im ken balah immah umishshum bittul pirya veribya:

Abal ishsha hallobeshet lebanim beyom hakkippurim — mutteret lirchotz qetzat ben yarkoteha, ben bechammin ben betzonen, dekevan sheal yede rechitza zo hi memaheret litbol uleshammesh, im ken hi rechitza shel mitzva, ukebar nitbaer shekkol rechitza shel mitzva mutteret beyom hakkippurim velo aseru ella keshemmitkavven letaanug:
